extractions.value: Inspiratory laryngeal stridor is highlighted as an important and novel symptom of PERM in this case. The patient had a subarachnoid hemorrhage caused by a fall during a tonic seizure. CA 199 (107 U/mL) and CA125 (36.9 U/mL) levels were increased. Follow-up duration was short and PET-CT was not performed.
